blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: World action models (WAMs) predict the visual consequences of the actions they generate, which makes test-time selection a natural way to improve a fixed policy: imagine the futures of candidate actions and execute the best one. The benefit of selection is bounded by the selectable headroom, how much better the best candidate truly is, but the standard estimate, which executes each candidate once and keeps the best outcome, conflates candidate quality with the randomness of everything that follows. We introduce a denoised counterfactual protocol, based on bitwise-reproducible branching, repeated continuations, held-out oracles, and common random numbers, that measures the headroom a selector can realize, and use its measurements to build a fail-gated selector. Across four WAMs, two benchmarks, over 100,000 branched rollouts, and pre-registered tests, we find that (i) the standard estimate overstates the selectable headroom of native samples: bounds from 17 continuations per candidate place its selectable share between 24% and 66% for three WAMs; (ii) structured action perturbations create up to 16 points of selectable headroom; and (iii) in both WAMs with action-conditioned imagination, imagined futures carry candidate-outcome information with no detectable loss relative to real futures, information that the value head of Cosmos Policy leaves unused. Deviating from the policy chunk only when a readout of the WAM predicts failure, the selector raises closed-loop task success from 76.9% to 81.6% on held-out episodes of training tasks, with the largest gain where the policy fails most often, and from 62.6% to 69.8% on unseen tasks.
blocks.zh: 世界行动模型(WAMs)预测它们产生的行动的视觉后果,这使得测试时间选择成为改进固定政策的自然方式:想象候选行动的未来,执行最好的行动. 选择的好处以可选的会议室为界,最佳候选人真正有多好,但标准估计使每个候选人执行一次并保持最佳结果,使候选人的质量与随后一切的随机性相混为一谈。 我们引入了基于比特-再生分支的去诺化反事实协议,重复续作,被搁置的甲骨文,以及常见的随机数,用来测量一个选择者能够实现的头室,并用它的测量来构建出一个被失败选择者. 在四个WAM中,两个基准,超过10万个分支的推出,以及预先登记的测试,我们发现(一) 标准估计过高地指出了当地样本的可选取头室:每个候选人17个续作的界限将其可选份额从24%到66%置于三个WAM之间;(二) 结构化的动作扰动创造了最多16个可选取头室的点;以及(三) 在两个WAM中,有行动条件的想象力,想象中的期货载有候选人结果信息,相对于真实的期货来说,没有可察觉的损失,关于宇宙政策的价值负责人未使用的信息。 只有在WAM的读取失败时,选择者才将封闭式启动任务的成功率从76.9%提高到81.6%,在被搁置的培训任务中,政策失败率最大,隐蔽任务成功率从62.6%提高到69.8%。

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en: World action models, which extend video-prediction policies and joint video-action models [ 11 , 50 , 21 , 29 , 58 ] , jointly produce an action chunk, a prediction of the scene after the chunk is executed, and an estimate of its value [ 25 ] . This structure makes a simple form of test-time compute available to any WAM: sample several candidate chunks, imagine where each of them leads, and execute the chunk whose imagined future looks best. Sampling-and-verification schemes of this kind, established for reasoning with language models [ 9 , 33 , 45 ] , have improved vision-language-action (VLA [ 24 , 5 ] ) policies [ 27 , 36 , 23 , 28 ] , and verifiers specific to WAMs have been proposed [ 56 , 55 ] .
blocks.zh: 世界行动模型,扩展了视频预测政策和视频联合行动模型[11,50,21,29,58],共同产生一个动作块,执行块后对场景的预测,以及估计其价值[25]. 这种结构使得任何WAM都可以使用一种简单的测试时间计算形式:对几个候选块进行抽样,想象每个块的走向,执行那些想象中未来看起来最好的块. 为与语言模型[9、33、45]进行推理而建立的这种抽样和核查计划改进了视觉语言行动(VLA[24、5])政策[27、36、23、28],并提出了针对WAM的核查人[56、55]。

blocks.en: How much can such selection gain? The answer is fixed before any scorer is chosen: the gain is bounded by how much better the best candidate in the pool truly is. We call this quantity the selectable headroom . Yuan et al. [53] measure it directly with counterfactual branching. They restore the same simulator state, execute each of 16 sampled candidates, continue each candidate with the policy until the episode ends, and find that choosing the candidate with the best outcome would raise success from 68.9% to 79.2%, whereas learned values, image similarity, and VLM judgments recover little of this gain.
blocks.zh: 这种选择能增加多少? 在选择任何计分员之前,答案是固定的:增益的界限是,在游泳池里最优秀的候选人究竟有多好。 我们称这个数量是可选择的 头室。 袁等编. [53]用反事实分支直接测量. 他们恢复了相同的模拟状态,处决了16个抽样候选人中的每一个,延续每个候选人的政策直到剧集结束,并发现选择有最佳结果的候选人会将成功率从68.9%提升到79.2%,而学习的价值观,图像相似性,以及VLM的判断几乎没有恢复这一收益.

blocks.en: This estimate executes each candidate once . Everything that happens after the candidate, including every later policy query, is random, so the candidate with the best realized outcome is partly the candidate whose continuation happened to go well. Selecting and scoring on the same random draw is the optimizer’s curse [ 44 ] , the same bias that double estimators remove in reinforcement learning [ 48 ] . The question that matters for selection is therefore how much of the oracle gain a selector could ever realize.
blocks.zh: 此估算会执行每个候选人一次 。 在候选人之后发生的一切,包括后来的每一个政策查询,都是随机的,因此,有最佳实现结果的候选人部分是其延续恰好顺利的候选人. 在相同的随机图上进行选择和评分是优化者的诅咒[44],与双评价器在强化学习中消除的偏差相同[48]. 因此,选择要紧的问题是,先知获得多少选择者才能意识到。

blocks.en: We answer this question with a denoised counterfactual protocol ( Fig. 2 a). Every candidate is executed from a bitwise-reproducible simulator snapshot and continued several times. The realizable part of the headroom is measured by a held-out oracle that selects on some continuations and is scored on others; a variance decomposition separates the effect of the candidate from its interaction with the continuation; and every evaluator is run with common random numbers, so that all candidates are compared under the same evaluation randomness. Using more than 100,000 branched rollouts of four WAMs, namely Cosmos Policy [ 25 ] , Flex- π \pi [ 51 ] , Fast-WAM [ 54 ] , and Streaming-WAM [ 22 ] , on RoboCasa [ 37 ] and LIBERO-Plus [ 14 ] , we establish the following results, each supported by pre-registered tests.
blocks.zh: 我们用一个虚伪的反事实议定书(图2a)来回答这个问题。 每个候选人都会从一个比特可复制的模拟快照中被执行,并持续了好几次. 头室的可实现部分通过一个搁置的甲骨文进行测量,该甲骨文在一些续作上进行选择,在另一些续作上进行打分;一个差异分解将候选人的效果与其与续作的互动分开;每个评价员都使用共同的随机数运行,这样所有候选人都在同一评价随机度下进行比较. 利用10万多个分支推出四个WAM,即宇宙政策[25],Flex-π\pi[51],Fast-WAM[54]和Streaming-WAM[22],在RoboCasa[37]和LiBERO-Plus[14]上,我们确定以下结果,每个结果都有预先登记的测试支持.

blocks.en: • The single-continuation oracle is dominated by continuation randomness ( Sec. 5.1 ). Under the protocol of Yuan et al. [53] , we reproduce a 12.3-point oracle gain, yet a selector that observes three independent outcomes per candidate realizes only 9% of it on a fresh continuation, and 98% of the candidate-specific outcome variation is re-drawn when the continuation seeds change. The same holds for all four WAMs on LIBERO-Plus. With 17 continuations per candidate, the selectable share lies between 24% and 52% of the single-continuation oracle for Cosmos Policy and between a third and two thirds for Flex- π \pi and Fast-WAM ( Fig. 1 ). • Structured proposals create selectable headroom ( Sec. 5.2 ). Native samples are nearly identical and offer almost no selectable headroom over the policy chunk, whereas displacing the policy chunk along the robot axes creates headroom of which 67–95% survives held-out evaluation for all four WAMs. This headroom lies where the policy chunk fails, and it exceeds the chunk by 4.5–16 points on both benchmarks and for all four WAMs. • The imagination carries the signal that the value head misses ( Sec. 5.3 ). On both WAMs with action-conditioned imagination, a linear readout of the imagined future ranks candidates with no detectable loss relative to the same readout of the real future; for Cosmos Policy, the signal resides in the predicted consequence rather than in the encoding of the action. The value head, although accurate at the state level (AUROC 0.90), recovers almost none of this signal. • A selector built on the findings improves on the policy ( Sec. 5.4 ). A learned failure gate decides whether to deviate from the policy chunk, and a learned ranker decides where to go, so the selector deviates only where the policy is likely to fail, which is where the headroom lies, and executes the policy chunk unchanged everywhere else. Frozen and pre-registered, it raises closed-loop task success from 76.9% to 81.6% on reserved episodes of the training tasks, by 10.7 points where the policy fails most often, and, when re-trained without the test tasks, from 62.6% to 69.8% on unseen tasks.

LIBERO-Plus上所有四个WAM也一样. 每名候选人有17次续修,可选份额占宇宙政策单续修预告的24%至52%,Flex- \pi和Fast-WAM(图1)占三分之一至三分之二。 原生样本几乎完全相同,在政策块上几乎没有可供选择的头部,而将政策块放在机器人轴上则创造了头部,其中67-95 % 生存了所有四个WAM的搁置评价。 这个大厅位于政策块失败的地方,在两个基准和所有四个WAM中都超过了4.5-16点。 想象力的信号是值头漏掉(第5.3节)。 在具有行动条件的想象力的两个WAM上,对所想象的未来进行线性读取,使候选人在真实未来的同一读取中没有可察觉的损失;就宇宙政策而言,信号存在于预期后果而不是动作的编码中。 数值头,虽然在州一级是准确的(AUROC 0.90),但几乎没有恢复这种信号. • 支助 以调查结果为基础的选择者改进了政策(第5.4节)。 一个学习的失败门决定是否偏离政策块,一个学习的排名者决定去哪里,所以选择者只在政策可能失败的地方偏离,也就是头室所在的地方,并且执行政策块在其它地方没有变化. 冷冻和预先登记后,在预留的培训任务中,闭机任务的成功率从76.9%提高到81.6%,在政策最经常失败的情况下,增加10.7分,在未完成测试任务的情况下,在未完成测试任务的情况下,增加62.6%提高到69.8%。

blocks.en: These results show when test-time selection can help a WAM: the headroom worth pursuing is created by proposals that displace the policy chunk rather than by native samples, the imagined futures of the model already carry information that ranks these proposals, and what is missing is a readout trained to compare sibling actions rather than to value states. Together, the results give a concrete recipe for test-time compute in a WAM: spend it on consequential proposals at states where the policy is likely to fail, score them with readouts trained on branch outcomes, and use the held-out oracle, at the cost of one extra continuation per candidate, to know in advance how much a selector can gain. We package the protocol and the branching data as HeadroomBench ( Sec. 6 ), which will be publicly released.
blocks.zh: 这些结果显示,当测试时间的选择可以帮助一个WAM:值得追求的头室是由取代政策块而不是本地样本的提案所创造的,模型的想象未来已经包含了这些提案的排序信息,所缺少的是一个经过培训的读出,以比较兄弟行为而不是评价状态. 结果共同给出了WAM中测试时间计算的具体方法:在政策可能失败的州投入到相应的建议上,用经过分支结果培训的读数来评分,并使用搁置的预告片,以每个候选人一次额外的续作为代价,提前知道选择者能获得多少收益. 我们把协议和分支数据包成Headroom Bench (Sec. 6),将公开发布.

blocks.en: 2 Related work
blocks.zh: 2 相关工作

blocks.en: RoboMonkey samples and perturbs VLA actions and selects among them with a VLM verifier [ 27 ] ; V-GPS re-ranks samples of generalist policies with an offline-RL value function [ 36 ] ; verifier-free sampling [ 23 ] and scaled verification [ 28 ] offer further variants; and BOKBO adds calibrated abstention when all candidates are poor [ 43 ] . For WAMs, Cosmos Policy plans with a fine-tuned value model on a real bimanual robot [ 25 ] ; Motus2 exposes a policy, an action-conditioned simulator, and a value model within a single network [ 4 ] ; GeoBoN scores imagined futures by multi-view geometric consistency [ 56 ] ; and World-Coherent Decoding ranks candidates by internal generative signals that are calibrated online against the mismatch between imagined and observed futures [ 55 ] . KeyStone selects without a judge by returning the medoid of the dominant cluster of sampled chunks [ 10 ] . Other work uses the imagination to refine a proposed chunk ( ω \omega -EVA [ 46 ] ) or to decide when to stop executing it by comparing predicted and observed futures (adaptive execution [ 49 ] ). In language models, the coverage of repeated sampling keeps growing while selection without an automatic verifier plateaus [ 6 ] , and best-of- n n selection over-optimizes a learned reward [ 16 ] . These works design selectors and verifiers; we measure the headroom for which they compete, identify where it comes from, and use these measurements to design a selector that improves the policy in closed loop.

[43]. 对WAMs来说,宇宙政策计划在真正的双人机器人上有一个精细的数值模型[25];Motus2在单一网络中暴露了一个政策,一个行动有条件的模拟器,以及一个价值模型[4];GeoBON通过多视角几何一致性来评分想象的未来[56];通过内部基因信号对候选人进行校准,与想象未来和观察未来不匹配[55]. KeyStone 选择时没有判断力, 方法是返回典型的样本块群的组分 [10] 。 其他作品则利用想象力来细化一个拟议的块(\\ omega-EVA [46]),或者通过比较预测和观察到的未来来决定何时停止执行(适应性执行[49]). 在语言模型中,重复采样的覆盖范围不断增长,而选择时没有自动验证高原[6],最佳n选择则过度优化所学的奖励[16]. 这些工程设计选择者和验证者;我们测量他们竞争的房头,确定它来自何处,并利用这些测量来设计一种在闭环中改进政策的选择者.

blocks.en: Learned world models have long served planning and control [ 15 , 12 , 18 , 19 , 57 ] . Recent work evaluates the dynamic consistency of WAM predictions [ 42 , 35 ] , guards policy optimization against model hallucination [ 8 , 31 ] , argues for decision-centric evaluation of world models [ 52 ] , shows that imperfect world models are exploitable [ 3 ] , and evaluates real policies with world models or simulation [ 32 , 30 ] . Closest to our work, Yuan et al. [53] introduce same-state counterfactual branching for test-time planning with WAMs on the same model and simulator. We build on their design, adopt their protocol for a direct comparison, and add repeated continuations, held-out oracles, controlled proposals, and representation-level readouts. Our held-out oracle addresses the optimizer’s curse [ 44 ] in the spirit of double estimators [ 48 ] , our evaluators use common random numbers [ 17 , 38 ] , and our key tests were pre-registered [ 39 ] , following recommendations for rigorous evaluation in reinforcement and robot learning [ 20 , 1 , 26 ] .
blocks.zh: 学习的世界模式长期以来为规划和控制服务[15、12、18、19、57]。 最近的工作评价了WAM预测的动态一致性[42,35],保护政策优化与模型幻觉[8,31],论证了以决定为中心的世界模型评价[52],表明不完美的世界模型是可以利用的[3],并用世界模型或模拟评价现实政策[32,30]. 最贴近我们的工作,袁等. [53] 在同一模型和模拟器上引入了同态反事实分支,用于与WAMs的测试时间规划. 我们以它们的设计为基础,通过它们的协议进行直接比较,并增加重复的续作、搁置的预告片、有控制的建议和代表级的读取。 我们被搁置的神谕本着双重估计者的精神解决了优化者的诅咒[44],我们的评估人员使用共同的随机数字[17,38],我们的关键测试经过预先登记[39],遵循了严格评估强化和机器人学习[20,1,26]的建议.

blocks.en: Value heads score either the real state after the action or the imagined path used at deployment: the policy is queried at s t b s_{t_{b}} , the candidate chunk is injected, the world model generates the future, and the value head scores it. To test whether the frozen representation encodes which candidate succeeds, we also fit linear probes [ 2 ] that predict the within-decision outcome p ^ c \hat{p}_{c} from the tokens of the final transformer block at the future-frame positions, centered within each decision point. The probes are weighted dual ridge regressions trained leave-one-state-out, and their predictions are residualized on the global direction estimated from the other states, so that a probe receives no credit for a direction that is good everywhere. The statistic is the within-decision Spearman correlation ρ \rho , and its null distribution is obtained by permuting outcomes within decision points and refitting the whole pipeline; p p -values count the observed statistic as one of the permutations [ 41 ] . All evaluator seeds are independent of the candidate.

blocks.zh: 4 实验设置

blocks.en: On RoboCasa, we use the public RoboCasa checkpoint of Cosmos Policy (2B parameters, 67.1% average success), which is fine-tuned from a Cosmos video world model [ 40 ] . Its public value head was trained only on demonstration replays; following the planning recipe of the original work, we fine-tune it on 1,200 policy rollouts and use the 15K-step model throughout. On LIBERO-Plus [ 14 ] , a perturbed version of LIBERO [ 34 ] that leaves room for improvement, we use the released LIBERO checkpoints of Cosmos Policy, Flex- π \pi [ 51 ] , Fast-WAM [ 54 ] , and Streaming-WAM [ 22 ] , each reproduced on LIBERO-10 within the CI of its published success rate. Following a rule fixed before any branching data were collected, we evaluate on the two perturbation categories on which every model succeeds 30–90% of the time, namely Objects Layout and Robot Initial States. All four WAMs enter the headroom measurements, the two whose released checkpoints imagine the consequences of given actions (Cosmos Policy and Streaming-WAM, the latter from the first 8 executed steps; Appendix B ) enter the imagination probes, and the selector is built on Cosmos Policy.
blocks.zh: 在RoboCasa上,我们使用Cosmos Policy的公共RoboCasa检查点(2B参数,67.1%的平均成功率),它从Cosmos的视频世界模型[40]中微调. 其公共价值负责人只接受了演示重播的培训;遵循原作品的规划配方,我们精细调整了1200个政策推广,并在整个过程中使用15K步模式. 在LIBERO-Plus [14],一个扰动的LIBERO [34] 版本留下了改进的余地,我们利用了已发布的LIBERO检查站Cosmos Policy,Flex-π\pi [51],Fast-WAM [54],以及Streaming-WAM [22],各在LIBERO-10上按其公布的成功率转载. 按照在收集任何分支数据之前确定的规则,我们评价每个模型在30-90%的时间内继承的两个扰动类别,即物体布局和机器人初始状态。 所有四个WAM都进入了头室测量,两个被放出的检查站都设想了特定行动的后果(宇宙政策和Streaming-WAM,后者来自前8个执行步骤;附录B)进入想象探测器,选择器基于宇宙政策.

blocks.en: We collect twelve branching datasets, four on RoboCasa and eight on LIBERO-Plus ( Tab. 4 in Appendix B ). Each dataset uses its own seed set, and initial-state hashes confirm that the datasets of each model do not overlap with one another or with the evaluation and training episodes. Every confirmatory test in the main text is pre-registered: its data, statistic, and criterion were registered before these data were collected ( Appendix A lists all 24 tests in the order of registration). Sections numbered with letters are in the appendix.

blocks.en: Three binary outcomes per candidate form a noisy basis for selection, so O ¯ L \bar{O}^{L} is, in expectation, a lower bound on the selectable headroom. To bound it from both sides, we extended every second-stage decision point of Cosmos Policy, Flex- π \pi , and Fast-WAM on LIBERO-Plus to 17 continuation schedules per candidate ( Fig. 6 in the appendix). For Cosmos Policy, the held-out share grows from 10% with one selection schedule to 24% [ 9 , 40 ] [9,40] with 16 and then flattens, whereas the in-sample oracle, whose expectation is an upper bound, reaches 52% [ 43 , 65 ] [43,65] ; the two bounds are 33% [ 15 , 50 ] [15,50] and 66% [ 55 , 79 ] [55,79] for Flex- π \pi and 33% [ 15 , 51 ] [15,51] and 63% [ 50 , 79 ] [50,79] for Fast-WAM. At 95% confidence, the single-continuation oracle thus overstates the selectable share of native headroom at least 1.5-fold for Cosmos Policy and 1.27-fold for the other two; in absolute terms, the upper bounds are 4.1, 2.8, and 4.0 points, against single-continuation estimates of 7.9, 4.3, and 6.4. Two alternative explanations do not hold. The estimator does not limit native candidates: on structured candidates, whose differences are real, three outcomes per candidate already recover 67–95% ( Fig. 1 b). blocks.en: Takeaway. The single-continuation oracle measures how often the continuation of some candidate succeeds, not how much better any candidate is; the two coincide only when continuations are deterministic. Held-out estimates, which require only one extra continuation per candidate, should accompany it whenever test-time selection is evaluated.

blocks.en: Three properties of this headroom determine what a selector must do. Perturbations spread outcomes in both directions: at κ = 0.5 \kappa=0.5 , the average perturbed candidate is 7–14 points below the policy chunk, so the gain goes to a selector that finds the right candidate. The gain also lies where the policy chunk fails: in all four WAMs, the held-out oracle exceeds the chunk by 0.21–0.44 wherever the chunk fails in a selection continuation and by − 0.02 -0.02 to + 0.01 +0.01 elsewhere (exploratory; Appendix E ), so a stronger policy leaves a smaller average margin. The right direction also depends on the state: on TurnOnStove, the direction main effect accounts for only 2–6% of τ ^ 2 \hat{\tau}^{2} , and a fixed direction chosen on other states does not improve on the policy chunk. Structured proposals thus create headroom that a selector realizes through state-dependent choices at states where the policy is likely to fail, which is the design target of Sec. 5.4 .

blocks.en: Takeaway. Within the pre-registered equivalence margin of ± 0.15 \pm 0.15 , a linear readout of the final-block tokens of the imagined future matches the same readout of the real future for both WAMs over the predicted horizon, and for Cosmos Policy the information resides in the predicted consequence. The component that falls short is the value head: its state-value objective is dominated by differences between states rather than between sibling actions, and within the predicted horizon the information available for selection is lost in its final projection, not in the predicted frames ( Appendix F ).

blocks.en: The findings indicate where a selector can win. For Cosmos Policy on LIBERO-Plus, + 0.104 +0.104 of the + 0.112 +0.112 held-out oracle comes from decision points at which the policy chunk fails in all four continuations, where even a random choice among the seven candidates gains 16 points. We therefore split selection into two decisions ( Fig. 2 b). A failure gate , a logistic readout of the representation that the WAM computes when imagining its own chunk, decides whether to deviate from the chunk; this is a state-level judgment of the kind that learned value heads make well, and the frames of the current scene alone match the full representation for this decision ( Appendix G ). World-Coherent Decoding [ 55 ] and adaptive execution [ 49 ] act on the mismatch between imagined and observed frames; the gate is instead trained on the task outcomes of counterfactual branches to predict when the policy chunk will fail. A ranker , the ridge readout of Sec. 5.3 applied to the imagination passes of twelve axis offsets ( κ ∈ { 0.1 , 0.5 } \kappa\in\{0.1,0.5\} ), decides where to go and is consulted only when the gate fires.
blocks.zh: 调查结果表明选择者可以在哪里获胜。 对于LIBERO-Plus的宇宙政策,+0.104+0.104 + 0.112 搁置的甲骨文来自决定点,在该决定点,政策块在所有四个续作中都失败了,即使七个候选人中随机选择也获得16分. 因此,我们把选择分成两个决定(图2b)。 一个故障门,一个WAM在想象自己的块时所计算出的表示的后勤读数,决定是否偏离块;这是一个州一级的判断,学到的价值头是好的,而目前的场景框架本身就与这一决定的充分表示相符(附录G)。 World-Coherent Decoding [55] 和适应性执行 [49] 行动在想象和观测到的帧之间不匹配;相反,大门接受了反事实分支任务结果的培训,以预测政策块何时会失败. 校对:Soup

blocks.en: On 400 new states (1,176 decision points; E9), the frozen selector improves on the policy chunk by + 2.0 ​ [ 0.7 , 3.4 ] +2.0\,[0.7,3.4] points per decision point ( Tab. 1 ). The gain comes from rescues: the selector deviates at 45% of decision points, where the policy chunk succeeds only 52% of the time, and where the policy chunk fails in all eight continuations, the chosen candidate succeeds 15% of the time. Behind the same gate, a random offset loses 1.9 points and the offset that performs best on the training set gains nothing, so the ranker contributes state-dependent choices rather than a fixed correction (both comparisons pre-registered). Within the training tasks, a ranker that reads only the current state and the commanded direction comes close to the full model in nested cross-validation ( + 1.9 +1.9 against + 2.5 +2.5 points; Appendix G ), so ranking there does not require the imagination. All features, regularization strengths, and thresholds were chosen on a training set (320 LIBERO-Plus states; E7) from a pre-declared grid by cross-validation over states (nested cross-validation estimates the gain of this procedure at + 2.5 ​ [ 0.9 , 4.1 ] +2.5\,[0.9,4.1] points), and the model was frozen before any test data existed.

blocks.en: Takeaway. Splitting the decision into whether to deviate and where to go turns measured headroom into pre-registered improvements over the policy. The gate spends the additional imagination where the policy is likely to fail, so the gain is largest where the policy is weakest.

blocks.en: 6 HeadroomBench
blocks.zh: 6个班奇

blocks.en: Our measurements are inexpensive to repeat, and their branching data are exactly what a selector needs for training, so we package both as HeadroomBench for public release. For any policy with seeded queries and any simulator with state snapshots, the headroom track measures the single-continuation oracle, the held-out share, the headroom over the policy chunk, and the variance decomposition, with state-clustered CIs, at a cost close to that of the standard protocol. The selector track provides a training split, a test split, and closed-loop evaluation lists, with reference results for value heads, random offsets, and both of our selectors ( Appendix H ). On its test split, the held-out oracle exceeds the policy chunk by 11 points, whereas selection by the value head and random selection both lose 8–10 points, which leaves most of the headroom open.

blocks.en: 7 Discussion and conclusion
blocks.zh: 7. 讨论和结论

blocks.en: Test-time selection can improve a world action model only as much as its selectable headroom allows. The single-continuation oracle measures how often the continuation of some candidate succeeds, whereas selection depends on how much better the best candidate is, which the held-out oracle measures at the cost of one extra continuation per candidate. Across four WAMs and two benchmarks, we find that the standard oracle largely reflects continuation randomness, that real headroom appears when proposals make consequential changes at states where the policy fails, and that information that helps find this headroom is already present in the imagined futures of the model, with no detectable loss relative to the real future. A selector that deviates only when a learned readout predicts failure improves on the policy at fresh decision points and in closed loop, gains most where the policy fails most often, and carries about half of its closed-loop gain over to tasks absent from its training.
blocks.zh: 测试时间的选择只有在其可选择的头室允许的范围内才能改进世界行动模式。 单次连续预告衡量一些候选人的继续成功频率,而甄选取决于最佳候选人的好坏程度,被搁置的预告衡量的代价是每个候选人额外继续一次。 在四个WAM和两个基准中,我们发现标准甲骨文在很大程度上反映了续作的随机性,当政策失败的州提出相应的修改建议时,真正的头室就出现了,帮助找到这个头室的信息已经存在于模型的想象未来,相对于真实的未来来说,没有可察觉的损失. 只有在有学识的阅读者预测政策在新的决策点和封闭循环中会改善失败时,选择者才会偏离政策,在政策最经常失败时收益最多,而将大约一半的封闭循环收益用于未接受培训的任务。

blocks.en: Our measurements cover four WAMs on two MuJoCo-based benchmarks, where bitwise-reproducible branching is available; the protocol requires only state snapshots and seeded policy queries and extends to any WAM and simulator that provide them. On physical robots, where a state cannot be restored exactly, repeated resets approximate the held-out estimate up to reset noise, whereas the selector itself needs no state restoration at deployment, because it scores offsets with the imagination of the WAM. Advantage heads trained on sibling branches, the data that our protocol produces, are a natural next step toward the held-out oracle.
blocks.zh: 我们的测量涵盖两个基于MujoCo的基准上的四个WAM,那里有位可复制的分支;协议只要求状态快照和种子政策查询,并延伸到任何提供它们的WAM和模拟器. 在物理机器人上,如果状态无法完全恢复,重复的重置大约是被搁置的估计值到重置噪声,而选择者本身在部署时不需要状态恢复,因为它的分数与WAM的想象力相抵消. 在兄弟会的分支方面训练有素的领袖们, 即我们协议所产生的数据, 是朝向坚守的神谕的下一个自然步骤。

blocks.en: Snapshot branching is validated against seeded replay at every decision point (the restored observations and proprioception equal those of the trunk), on spot-check episodes (full episodes are byte-identical, including JPEG frames), and by re-running episodes in fresh processes. Every rollout also passes online and offline rendering checks. These checks guard against a failure mode of robosuite [ 59 ] that we identified while reproducing the baseline: the previous rendering context can be released by the garbage collector in the middle of an episode, which deletes same-named frame buffers of the active context and corrupts all subsequent frames (20 of 3,600 baseline evaluation episodes were affected). We force garbage collection at fixed points and verify frames online by read-back and offline by a frame-integrity scan. The LIBERO stack releases rendering contexts synchronously at reset, and the same checks are applied there. Flagged rollouts were adjudicated with four criteria (the online check passed, the other cameras are continuous, visual inspection, and a byte-identical re-run in a fresh process). All of them were adjudicated as false positives caused by fast wrist-camera motion over high-contrast textures, except two rollouts in which the wrist camera turns dark while the gripper is inside a dark container (one in E7 and one in E9); both meet all four criteria and were retained as genuine occlusions, and removing them changes no reported result by more than 0.003.
blocks.zh: 快照分支在每一个决定点(恢复的观测和自控等效于树干),即时检查(整集为字节-等效,包括JPEG帧)和通过在新流程中重播插曲进行验证. 每次推出也都会通过线上和线下渲染检查. 这些检查防止我们复制基线时确定的robosoite [59] 的故障模式:前一渲染上下文可以由垃圾收集器在一个插曲的中间释放,它删除了活动上下文的同名帧缓冲器,并腐蚀了所有后续帧(3600个基线评价中20个受到影响). 我们在固定点强制收集垃圾,通过回读和离线扫描在线验证帧。 LIBERO堆栈在重置时会同步渲染上下文,并在此应用同样的检查. 以四项标准(在线检查通过、其他摄像机连续进行、目视检查和在新过程中进行字节相同重播)裁定了标志性的推出。 所有这一切都被裁定为由快速手腕-摄像头运动在高孔纹理上造成的假阳性,只有两次展开,其中腕相机变暗,而抓手则在一个暗的容器内(一次在E7,一次在E9);两者均符合所有四个标准,并被保留为真闭塞,并且以0.003以上去除没有报告结果的改变.

blocks.en: The released LIBERO checkpoints of Cosmos Policy, Flex- π \pi ( flexpi-libero-fulljoint-star ), Fast-WAM ( libero_uncond_2cam224 ), and Streaming-WAM ( ac-stream ) were reproduced on LIBERO-10 with their official evaluation scripts (50 episodes each: 96%, 98%, 94%, and 100%, all within the CI of the published values). Each model received a per-query seed interface that changes only the random seed; full episodes are byte-identical across fresh processes and concurrent workers, and snapshot branching is byte-identical to seeded replay for every model. Streaming-WAM is designed for asynchronous execution, in which each query is conditioned on the 8 actions already committed from the previous chunk. Our protocol queries a policy once and executes its chunk, so we issue every 16 steps the call that its official controller uses at the start of an episode, which takes no committed prefix; with this synchronous schedule, it succeeds in 50 of 50 LIBERO-10 episodes. To imagine a candidate, we use the call with a committed prefix, which accepts exactly 8 actions: the first 8 of the 16 executed steps of the candidate are supplied, and the model predicts the rest. Because axis offsets are constant along the chunk, this prefix fixes the direction and size of the offset. The probe reads the 98 final-block tokens of the video expert at the latent frame that covers steps 4–16, and real futures are encoded into the same positions with the VAE of the model. Imagined and real latents agree closely for the policy chunk (cosine 0.92) and less for offsets (0.75–0.80), consistent with the unseen second half of the chunk. Native sampling of Streaming-WAM is stochastic (ratio of the standard deviation of chunks across seeds 0.040, against 0.015–0.12 for the other models), and it succeeds 71% and 88% of the time on the two selected categories. RynnVLA-002 [ 7 ] decodes greedily in its official configuration, so its native candidates are identical; the study therefore uses the four WAMs above.
blocks.zh: 在LiBERO-10上,发布了LIBERO的Cosmos Policy、Flex- \pi(flexpi-libero-full joint-star ),Fast-WAM(libero_uncond_2cam224)和Streaming-WAM(ac-stream )检查站及其官方评价脚本(每集50集:96%、98%、94%和100%,均在公布的数值的CI之内)。 每个模型都得到一个只改变随机种子的每克种子接口;全集是跨新工艺和同时代工人的字节-相同,快照分支是每个模型的种子重播的字节-相同. Streaming-WAM是为同步执行而设计的,其中每个查询都以先前块中已经执行的8个动作为条件. 我们的协议询问一个政策,然后执行它的块,所以我们每16个步骤发出一次它的官方控制器在一集开始时使用的呼叫,它没有承诺的前缀;有了这个同步的时间表,它就成功在50个LIBERO-10集中的50个. 想象一个候选人,我们使用一个承诺前缀的呼叫,它完全接受8个动作:候选人16个执行步骤中的第一个8个得到供应,模型预测了其余部分. 由于轴偏移沿块是恒定的,这个前缀固定了偏移的方向和大小. 探测器在潜伏的框架上读取了视频专家的98个最终块符号,这些符号涵盖步骤4-16,真实的未来被编码成与模型的VAE相同的位置. 与未见的下半部分一致, 设想和真正的潜伏因素对政策块( 0. 92) 和抵消( 0. 75– 0. 80) 都非常一致。 Streaming-WAM的原生采样具有斯图克性(在0.040种种子中块的标准偏差率,而其他模型为0.015-0.12),在两个选定类别上成功的时间为71%和88%。 RynnVLA-002 [7]在官方配置中贪婪地解码,因此其本土候选人完全相同;因此研究使用了上面的四个WAM.

blocks.en: Three properties of LIBERO matter for reproducible branching, and we handle them uniformly. The global random state is seeded before every reset; a fresh environment is created for every episode and branch, because repeated resets of one environment object append placement samplers that move articulated fixtures by up to 1.3 cm; and snapshots store the trunk observation, because LIBERO-Plus adds sensor noise inside the step function of its wrapper. The task names of LIBERO-Plus carry perturbation suffixes; except in the language category, we use the original LIBERO instruction, and all success rates refer to these instructions.
blocks.zh: LIBERO物质的三个特性 用于可复制的分支, 我们统一处理它们。 全球随机状态在每次重置前都会播种;每集和分支都会创造新鲜的环境,因为重复重播一个环境对象附件的放置采样器,可移动的精密定着物可达1.3厘米;快照存储树干观测,因为LIBERO-Plus在其包装器的步函数内会添加传感器噪声. LIBERO-Plus的任务名称带有扰动后缀;除了语言类别,我们使用原始的LIBERO指令,所有成功率都参考了这些指令.

blocks.en: A list of 168 episodes (4 suites × \times 7 categories × \times 6) was run with every model before any branching data were collected. The rule announced beforehand selects the categories on which all models succeed 30–90% of the time, namely Objects Layout and Robot Initial States. E5 draws 80 states (10 per suite and category) shared by all models, and E6 draws 56 different states. E5 + uses 17 continuation schedules at every second-stage decision point of E5, namely the first-stage schedule j = 0 j=0 , the four second-stage schedules j = 1..4 j=1..4 , and the new schedules j = 5..16 j=5..16 , all shared across candidates; its estimates average over these 17 schedules, whereas those of E5 use j = 1..4 j=1..4 , so the two estimates of O ¯ 1 \bar{O}^{1} differ (for example, 7.9 against 7.3 points for Cosmos Policy). E11 draws 192 further states (24 per suite and category) for Streaming-WAM alone; they exclude F1, E5, E6, E8, and E10, and because the other robot initial-state episodes are all in E10, they may coincide with states of E7 and E9, which contain only Cosmos Policy (21 and 25 identical initial frames). blocks.en: KeyStone [ 10 ] returns the medoid of the largest cluster of sampled chunks. Because every native candidate in our data has repeated continuations, its choice can be scored without bias. Table 7 reports KeyStone with its default settings on all native-candidate sets; the analysis plan was fixed before the chunks were exported. In the main analysis, no estimate differs from zero. Of the twelve reference and sensitivity intervals in the table, two exclude zero (the global medoid on E3 and KeyStone on executed actions for Flex- π \pi ); computed on executed actions, the global medoid also exceeds zero on E3 ( + 0.027 +0.027 ) and for Fast-WAM ( + 0.019 +0.019 ). Given the number of comparisons, we treat these results as exploratory; they are small and positive, as expected if consensus selection mainly avoids outlying samples. At a single decision point, the consensus candidate is therefore no better than a random one, consistent with native candidates differing mostly by continuation noise, and our per-decision estimates bound its effect at about 0.4 points per query on LIBERO-Plus. The unimodality guard fires at 10 of the 172 decision points (first initialization).

blocks.en: This selector shows why the decision to deviate needs its own model. Its features are the final-block tokens of the imagined future frames of Cosmos Policy (one imagination seed), centered within each decision point and standardized, together with a centered one-hot code of the candidate. A weighted dual ridge model predicts p ^ \hat{p} , and the selector deviates from the policy chunk only when the best predicted candidate exceeds the policy chunk by more than τ \tau ; the ridge strength a a and τ \tau were chosen by five-fold cross-validation over states on E7, and the final model was evaluated once on E6. Because an average offset is worse than the policy chunk, every finite threshold has a negative cross-validated gain, and cross-validation selects τ = ∞ \tau=\infty ( Tab. 11 ); the same holds when training on the first 80, 160, or 240 states of each cell, and a model with only the one-hot code (a fixed direction) never deviates either, because the policy chunk has the highest average outcome. The gain improves monotonically with a a up to the edge of the pre-registered grid ( a ≤ 10 2 a\leq 10^{2} ), which is narrower than the ranker grid of the fail-gated selector ( a = 10 2 a=10^{2} – 10 6 10^{6} ); in an exploratory extension to a = 10 3 a=10^{3} – 10 6 10^{6} , some finite thresholds reach a cross-validated gain of up to + 0.02 +0.02 (a maximum over the same folds, without nested cross-validation or a CI), so the two selectors were not tuned with matched grids. Within the pre-registered grid, ranking alone never deviates from a strong policy chunk, and a separate failure gate supplies the decision to deviate. Because this selector never deviates, its closed-loop evaluation was not run.
blocks.zh: 这个选择器显示为什么偏离的决定需要自己的模式. 它的特征是"宇宙政策"的想象未来框架(一个想象种子)的最后块符号,以每个决定点为中心并标准化,加上一个候选人的中心一热码. 加权双脊模型预测p ^\ hat{p},只有在最佳预测候选人超过政策块超过\ tau 时,选择者才会偏离政策块; 脊力 a 和\ tau 是通过在 E7 上对状态进行五倍的交叉验证来选择的,最后模型在 E6 上评价过一次。 由于平均抵消比政策块还差,每个有限阈值都有负的交叉验证收益,交叉验证选择了\\\\\\\\\\\infty(Tab. 11);当每个单元格的前80、160或240个状态的训练时,同样的情况,只有一个热码(固定方向)的模型也从未偏离,因为政策块的平均结果最高。 收益单调提高,在预先注册的网格边缘(XQ 10 2 a\leq 10^{2})上,它比失败选择器的分级网格(a = 10 2 a= 10^{2} – 10 6 10^{6})要窄;在探索性扩展到 = 10 3 a= 10^{3} – 10 6 10^{6}中,一些限定阈值达到交叉验证的增益,最高为 +.02 + 0.02 (在同一折叠面上最高,没有嵌套交叉验证或CI),因此两个选择器没有对应的网格调. 在预先注册的电网内,单靠排名永远不会偏离一个强大的政策块,单独的故障门会提供偏离的决定. 由于这个选择器从未偏离,所以其闭路评价没有运行.

blocks.en: The gate is an L2-regularized logistic regression that predicts the failure of the policy chunk from the imagination of the WAM for that chunk; it is trained on the first-stage outcome of all 944 E7 decision points and on the two second-stage outcomes where they are available (with two-stage weights). The ranker is the dual ridge model described above, centered within the candidate set. With the gate score q ⁡ ( a ) q(a) of the policy chunk a a , the threshold θ \theta , the offset set 𝒞 \mathcal{C} , and the ranker score r ⁡ ( c ) r(c) , the selector executes arg ⁡ max c ∈ 𝒞 ​ r ​ ( c ) \arg\max_{c\in\mathcal{C}}r(c) if q ⁡ ( a ) > θ q(a)>\theta and a a otherwise. The pre-declared grid covered the gate features (all nine latent frames of the imagination pass, or the current-observation frames together with the value), the gate regularization ( C ∈ { 10 − 4 , … , 1 } C\in\{10^{-4},\dots,1\} ), the ranker strength ( a ∈ { 10 2 , … , 10 6 } a\in\{10^{2},\dots,10^{6}\} ), the ranker training set (all second-stage decision points, or only those at which the chunk failed), the candidate set (6 or 12 offsets), and the threshold (50th–90th percentile of the gate score), for 1,000 configurations in total. Cross-validation over the same five state folds as for ranking with abstention selected all nine frames, C = 10 − 4 C=10^{-4} , all decision points, 12 offsets, a = 10 5 a=10^{5} , and the 60th percentile (cross-validated gain + 0.028 +0.028 ); the same gate with a random offset gives − 0.021 -0.021 , and with the best fixed direction at most + 0.011 +0.011 . Nested cross-validation (5 outer × \times 5 inner folds) estimates the gain of the whole selection procedure at + 0.025 ​ [ 0.009 , 0.041 ] +0.025\,[0.009,0.041] , with deviation at 35% of held-out decision points and a gate AUROC of 0.88; by category, the gain is + 0.055 +0.055 on robot initial states and − 0.005 -0.005 on object layouts. On E6, inspected once after freezing and only descriptively, the selector gains + 0.020 ​ [ − 0.028 , 0.076 ] +0.020\,[-0.028,0.076] in the κ = 0.5 \kappa=0.5 pool. blocks.en: At each decision point, a selector scores candidate chunks with the imagination of the WAM and chooses one; the score is the success gain over executing the policy chunk. The training split is E7 (320 states, 944 decision points), where every decision point offers 13 candidates, namely the policy chunk and twelve axis offsets at κ = 0.1 \kappa=0.1 and 0.5, with outcomes and imagined-future representations. The test split is E6 (56 disjoint states, four continuations per candidate), whose offsets at κ = 0.1 \kappa=0.1 and 0.5 were screened as separate arms; its primary pool is therefore the policy chunk and the six offsets at κ = 0.5 \kappa=0.5 , among which a selector trained on 13 candidates chooses, and the package also scores all 13 candidates at the decision points where both arms were measured. Two lists of further episodes (E8 and E10) serve closed-loop evaluation; each has been used once, for the closed-loop tests of Sec. 5.4 . Table 14 gives the reference results. The held-out oracle exceeds the policy chunk by 11 points, whereas selection by the value head and random selection both lose 8–10 points. The split thus rewards selectors that deviate selectively: the ranking signal in the imagination is real ( ρ ≈ 0.2 \rho\approx 0.2 ), but an average offset costs 8–10 points, so ranking with abstention stays with the policy chunk, and the fail-gated selector of Sec. 5.4 gains + 0.020 +0.020 (E6 informed its design; its held-out evaluation is the one on E9).
